TSFIX-1015 numerical arm (default OFF), not a material parameter. 1: node-only staggered reciprocal thermal coupling eliminates both proximal alpha terms and subtracts the cached previous-anchor velocity; exact white FDT for fixed-geometry overdamped free nodes. Derivation and limits: outputs/lanes_1015/TSFIX/HANDBACK.md; host covariance algebra only, no device verification. Needs fluid_thermal_stress, partitioned coupling, float64, no coupled faces. No amplitude is fitted.

FLUIDRES 2026-10-16 user-authorized default-OFF arm after 72f9ae9aa two-held-pressure refusal. Exact Dirichlet lifting of the existing pressure_patch values: q_bar=dt*dx/eta*p_bar, B_f=-(eta*dx/dt)*K_fluid[0;q_bar]. Both held tags are excluded from corrections; -B dot Y enters gradient and merit; physical pressure restores p_bar. No new pressure law, scale, gate or stop. Host algebra/codegen only until native confirmation.
implicit elastic step: 1e5 x the explicit limit gamma/k ~ 1e-10 s of a solvent-dragged 50 nm actin segment; EXPLICIT stepping needs ~1e-11 s

iterations m of the fast-mode chain zeta_j = M^-1 (W zeta_(j-1) + xi_K) realised beside the trajectory for observables (energy.fastmodes; DESIGN-2026-09-24-c5-fast-modes, PI 20:27 A2): per mode Var zeta = kT/(2D+k) (1 - (1+k/D)^-2m); the worst unfilled share of kT/k is 9.0 / 4.6 / 3.1 % at m = 1 / 2 / 3 (near k = 0.6 / 0.3 / 0.2 D), none for a stiff mode; one linear solve per iteration per recorded sample
outer Uzawa iterations per step; the achieved Stokes residual is recorded every step, never compared

positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

numerical CAP, not physics and not the expected count: the most Jacobi-PCG updates the backward-Euler edge solve of physics.surface_count_flow may spend in one step. The solve stops on its own criterion (no face count wrong by one unit of material: ||r||_2 <= 1/(dt sqrt(6) c_max), module docstring 'Convergence'), warm-started from the last flux where that start is nearer; a step that reaches this cap first is recorded as under-solved (report solve_cap_hit = 1, with solve_defect_norm against solve_stop_norm), never rejected. The launches are fixed (no host read inside the step), so a converged solve spends the remainder as device no-ops. 4096 = 2 x the CG Chebyshev bound 0.5 sqrt(kappa) ln(2/eps) at the finest swept spacing (resolution.spacing 0.05 um; kappa <= 1 + 6 dt c g ~ 4.1e4 at dt 1e-2, eps ~ 3e-9 on a 7.5 um GUV) ~ 2.1e3; the host mirror needed 787 cold updates on a 0.07 um GUV icosphere with 1 % count noise. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation and solve diagnostics; the per-face count and the warm-start flux are declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

the physical run length a build's runtime RESERVES are sized for (PLAN-2026-10-03-inventory-transport-adhesion stage 2: 'derive the reserve size from the run length'; runs of 20-30 s there, the upper end taken). A declared protocol number, not a cell property; read by derive.records_per_site (arp23.nucleation_records_per_site). A run longer than this saturates its reserve and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised — the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. C29PERM user-authorized alternative dissipation arm, 2026-10-16; default OFF. Normal gamma=|J|^2/(Lp A) from monolithic.node_rows_np; tangent is the projected incumbent grid-friction quadrature. Replaces rank-one volume dissipation on declared permeable surfaces. Reciprocal reaction and matched force-noise factor, no fitted scale. Host constitutive evidence only; native validation pending.
red-black sweeps of the solvent block's symmetric smoother in the monolithic step's block preconditioner (coupled_solve.MacCoupledSolve.precondition): a solver setting, recorded in the ledger

MINRESPC PI task 2026-10-16: default-OFF numerical arm, same saddle and FDT. Closed-box A=-dx^2 Laplace, B=dx grad; pressure inverse I or (B.T diag(A)^-1 B)^+; membrane nodes keep the existing augmented 3x3 inverse. Static aggregation Galerkin V-cycle: aggregate size from amg.device.factor, bottom cap from amg.device.bottom, paired sweeps from sim.monolithic_smoother_sweeps, Jacobi weight derived from the absolute row-sum bound. No result-selected coefficient. Internal walls and pressure patches explicitly unsupported in this arm. Host algebra only, device validation pending.

MINRESFLUX PI task 2026-10-16 (direction Lead, work session 6d host finding outputs/diag_1013/minres_flux_1016): default-OFF exact change of constraint basis K' = T K T^T, b' = T b, x = T^T x'; T is the identity except the flux rows. c_s = argmin ||b_s - B_p^T c|| from B_p B_p^T c = B_p b_s (closed-box pressure Laplacian, gauge c[0]=0) by AMG-PCG with the static aggregation hierarchy (amg.device.factor, amg.device.bottom, paired sweeps sim.monolithic_smoother_sweeps), warm-started, fixed budget sim.monolithic_minres_iters, scalar guards implicit._TINY; no tolerance, no fitted coefficient. Any invertible T gives the same solution; c_s changes only conditioning. Flux preconditioner scalar = diagonal Schur 1/(r_s P_u r_s^T). Refreshed with SaddleOperator.refresh. Refuses: no closed surface, internal walls, pressure boundaries/patches, tangent slip rows. Host algebra only, device validation pending.

MINRES iterations per Newton iteration of the monolithic surface-solvent step (energy.monolithic; DESIGN-2026-09-25-c5-monolithic-stage2 §4, PI M7): a fixed budget, the recurrence's residual estimate recorded per iteration, never compared; PREREG-2026-09-25-c5-monolithic-physics Q-a predicts <= 1000 to 1e-8 at L = 64 dx

Existing smaller algorithmic budgets and their records stay unchanged. Maximum is the signed device counter range.

Default OFF through sim.loop_guard_enabled. Checked between Python iterations/queries; cannot interrupt an in-flight C or driver call.

HANGHUNT user-authorized solver candidate, 2026-10-16: default OFF. 1 applies rho_j = rho_reference * (1 + j * sim.face_area_penalty_increment) inside the existing face-area ALM rounds, j zero based; resets the schedule at each physical step, carries multipliers, keeps targets and stop rules. Exact-inner host algebra only; eca7e19/native seed 1/2 evidence unavailable in this lane, so this is a candidate, not a diagnosed native fix.

Numerical continuation increment in units of the reference penalty per ALM round. Unit ramp is an explicit solver example, not fitted to device measurements; sweep from constant penalty (0) to adding one reference penalty per round (1). With the existing 10 rounds, scale is 1 through 10, not a new iteration cap. No area tolerance, multiplier convergence test or threshold added. Host algebra: error contraction K/(K+A0*rho_j) for an affine area constraint and SPD quadratic; not a general convergence guarantee for inexact/nonconvex U1 solves.

B8STALL method arm: 0 retains incumbent rejection of a short edge incident to a locked node; 1 permits collapse onto exactly one locked endpoint at its unchanged position, retaining its identity and geometric ancestry. Both locked endpoints still refuse. Existing link, normal, length and conservation checks remain. Boolean alternatives, not a value fitted to a record; host-written only.

pair capacity as a multiple of the pair count at build (build_barrier headroom >= 1): 2 lets the listed pairs double between rebuilds before the device overflow flag asks for a rebuild. An allocation margin, not physics

the additive-CCD fraction c of the pairwise barrier (build_barrier safety in (0, 1)): a listed pair keeps (1 - c) of its gap beyond xi per iteration. NUMERICAL CHOICE, not a physical parameter (PI 2026-09-24 09:05, contact Q2): it sets how many iterations a closing pair takes, never the barrier law or where contact holds; 0.9 is the same fraction as contact.sdf.eta. Method source: additive CCD (Li, Kaufman, Jiang 2021, Codimensional Incremental Potential Contact, ACM TOG 40(4)) — NOT in the KB (no row names it, checked 2026-09-24) and the paper's own value is not checked here; registration goes through the KB procedure, not this file
barrier._PAR_EPS: det <= eps |u|^2|v|^2 treated as parallel edges / sliver (exact at its boundary minimum)
barrier._COINCIDENT_UM: tie band of the start census (1e5 x roundoff of a 10 um coordinate)
barrier_term._JACOBI_SWEEPS: fixed Jacobi rotations of the 5x5 factor (converged in ~6)

start margin delta = d_hat, PI 2026-09-23 21:24; EXAMPLE. Numerical, not biological: the barrier activation distance of the energy core's contact terms (aleph/physics/energy/sdf.py, barrier.py) and the margin every builder places beyond contact, so the built cell carries zero barrier energy. Present = the builders place against the BUILT surface meshes (aleph/cell/build/clearance.py) and assemble refuses a node short of exclusion radius + half-thickness + d_hat.

barrier stiffness of b(d) = -kappa (d - d_hat)^2 ln(d/d_hat) (energy/sdf.py, energy/barrier.py). It pushes back with |b'(d_hat/2)| = kappa d_hat (ln 2 + 1/2), so kappa = F_hold / (d_hat (ln 2 + 1/2)) holds F_hold at half the activation distance: F_hold = 100 pN is a number stated here, not a row (the order of the largest bond force of the lane build, as the Lead gave it 2026-09-24 00:2x; not re-measured), and d_hat = contact.d_hat 0.005 um give 1.676e4. A VALUE computed at authoring time (PI 2026-09-29 decision 12: kept valued). Re-compute when contact.d_hat or F_hold changes. Numerical, not in KB source_audit

the SDF line-search fraction (SdfParams.eta in (0, 1)): in one line search a node-face pair may close at most eta of its gap at the line search's START (the swept-CCD floor is (1 - eta) gap(0), so 0.9 leaves 10 %), however many advances the bound takes (C3 39c6161b8). NUMERICAL CHOICE, not a physical parameter (PI 2026-09-24 09:05, contact Q2): it sets how far one line search may advance toward a face — how many iterations contact takes, never the contact law or where contact holds. The same fraction as contact.barrier.safety, so both contact terms leave the same share of a gap per line search. Method source: additive CCD (Li, Kaufman, Jiang 2021, Codimensional Incremental Potential Contact, ACM TOG 40(4)) — NOT in the KB (no row names it, checked 2026-09-24); registration goes through the KB procedure, not this file

solver iterations between SDF refreshes (SdfParams.refit_every >= 1). 1 = the budgets and the closest faces are rebuilt every Newton iteration: the tightest and costliest choice; a larger value trades face hand-over latency for fewer BVH refits. Numerical
SdfTerm ccd_iters default: additive-CCD bound evaluations per pair
SdfTerm history default: records kept
sdf.LAZY_REPAIR_ROUNDS: lazy limit-repair rounds per limit call (cap counted when reached)
sdf.TRIAL_CAP: most candidate faces one trial query visits; beyond it the trial is INVALID (+inf)

freebody._surface_exact (LOCAL-1013): relative slack 2^-20 of the float32 query box that bounds which faces the exact float64 check visits, on the sum (max |coordinate| + |p| + reach). The float32 roundings it must cover (each surface vertex, the query point, the half-width, the two box corners) total <= 2^-23 of that sum (IEEE-754 binary32 half-ulp 2^-24 each); 2^-20 is 8x that. Lower bound of the range = 2^-22 (2x). Not physics: a larger value only visits more faces, the verdict is unchanged. Comparison arm (the pre-LOCAL-1013 cost): 1.0e9 makes the box cover every face of the wall — the all-faces visit and the all-faces minimum distance; the side stays the pseudonormal rule (the summed-solid-angle rule itself is at the base SHA only)
freebody.MAX_REFLECT: reflections before a point is counted unresolved

strand-contact-1009 (Lead/PI AUTO-1009-ALL 2026-10-10, decision 2): 1 = the build's strand-strand clearance pass (cell/build/clearance.clear_strand_pairs) moves every non-exempt pair of strand capsules out of xi before the world is made, and the crosslinker centres clear of strands and each other before their arms are drawn. A declared build arm, default 0 = the build as before; once on, ContactScope.start_guard returns for the universal launches. F9-1013: the pass now ends with 0 strand pairs inside xi and the surface check passing on C02, P05 AND U1 (host), but the row stays 0: on a whole-cell build it pushes the DECLARED bundles apart too (their filament spacing lies inside the xi + d_hat it clears to: the coarse cell's filopodium then occupies no bundle relation), and two placements after it put pairs back inside xi (bound NMII heads; crosslinker centres drawn near the filaments) — see ALL_ON.toml
clearance.clear_strand_pairs: Jacobi push rounds before the pass stops and REPORTS the pairs still short (never a density change); the surface pass's own cap (clear_segments max_rounds 40)

clearance._combine (F9-1013): Kaczmarz sweeps over a node's asks (its short pairs' shares, its near pairs' slack shares) in one push round. Not physics: more sweeps only bring a node's displacement closer to the point that meets all its asks. Measured on the U1 host build (119,932 short pairs, 56,787 inside xi at the start, 40 rounds): 2 sweeps leave 2 pairs inside xi, 3 leave 0; the mean it replaces left 1,062

assemble.build_tables / clearance.clear_strand_pairs (F9-1013): a strand pair closer than xi + this x contact.d_hat after a cycle is CLOSE — the build runs another cycle, and that cycle's release pass pushes exactly the close pairs out to xi + d_hat. 0 = only the pairs inside xi (the start guard's count). Above 0 because a pair a hair outside xi is no start either: the log barrier's force is kappa (2 x ln(e/d_hat) + x^2/e), x = e - d_hat, i.e. 1.19 kappa d_hat at e = d_hat/2 and growing as 1/e below (12 kappa d_hat at d_hat/10; the first U1 build that reached 0 inside xi left one pair at e < 5e-4 nm). 0.5 = the lower half of the band, a convention, not fitted to a count; SWEPT-able: 1.0 releases every in-band pair (and gives up keeping their chords)

assemble.build_tables (F9-1013; was the literal 2): cycles of (strand pass, whole surface pass, census) before the build goes on with what is left; cycle 0 keeps every chord and junction distance, later cycles release the close pairs (release_gap_rel); a cycle is the last once no pair is close after the surface pass. C02, P05 host builds end in cycle 0, U1 in cycle 1; what is left after the cap is REPORTED (STRAND_REPORT overlap_after_surfaces) and the universal launches' start census then records it or refuses (CoreOptions.start_overlaps)

MOTOR2-1014 (2026-10-14): the universal contact's BOND exemption rule (energy/barrier.py _exempt, universal_pairs_np), a declared arm. 0 = today: a node pair joined by a live relation is exempt only when the relation's rest is below the pair's xi. 1 = below xi + contact.d_hat, the bound the contour rule already uses: a relation resting inside the barrier's activation band can never sit at its rest while the pair is listed (the barrier is active there and +inf at xi), so contact holds it in tension at every step. Found by the MOTOR-1014 stroke twin: the crossbridge rests at r_md + r_actin = xi by derivation and the barrier pushes it to ~11.7 nm (d - xi ~ 0.9 d_hat). Excluding bonded 1-2 pairs from the non-bonded excluded volume is the molecular-dynamics convention. With 1, a bound tip's distance from its own actin segment is the relation's and the head's angle laws' (law 6, nmii.md_actin_radial_k_theta, holds it radial; without law 6 the tip pivots about its site at zero energy), every OTHER actin segment stays a pair. A rule, not a fitted number

numerical: the fluid box's cell count per side stated outright (cell/assemble.grid_box); 0 = derive the box from fluid.padding. For a series that must place the wall at a chosen distance with a chosen multigrid depth (CALIBRATION-2026-09-20): refused if odd, if not a multiple of fluid.cells_multiple, or if the box does not hold max|x| + fluid.padding, which then acts as a floor

switch, not a material value: 1 sizes the fluid box per axis (each axis its own nodes' extent + fluid.padding, a multiple of fluid.cells_multiple) instead of the cube around max|x| — an instrument such as a pipette then extends only its own axis (#134, Lead 22:2x; DESIGN-2026-09-24-c5-pipette-suction §2: 576 x 336 x 336 against 816^3 at native for a 12 um tube). Coarsens nothing (directive 6). On the staggered grid each axis is rounded to a multiple of lcm(fluid.cells_multiple, 16), so the device's own +side rounding is a no-op and the box stays centred on its nodes (C1 22:4x). 0 = the cube as it always was; exclusive with fluid.box_cells

numerical, not biological: cell/assemble.grid_box rounds the fluid box's cell count per side UP to a multiple of this, SYMMETRICALLY. The staggered device grid already rounds to 16 by itself (physics.fluid_mac.MacGrid) but puts the extra cells on the + side only, so the built box is off-centre (row-1 native: 362 asked, 368 built, + walls 0.30 um farther) and is not the box the tables record; 16 here makes the device's rounding a no-op. It buys NO multigrid depth — a first version of this row claimed the native grid had two levels; it has five (368 = 16 x 23), and that claim is withdrawn (2026-09-21). 1 = the box as it always was
water density 1 g/cm^3 = 1 pg/um^3 (physical constant)

FLUIDRES, PI 2026-10-16 02:42 item 3 via b3: default-OFF resolution arm. 1 derives realized Cartesian fluid spacing as max(fluid.dx, next_float(max strand R / fluid.r_eff.a)); next_float enforces a*dx > R in float64. Tube box bounds also enclose the existing _tube_masks cap (far end + dx/2 + declared wall thickness; radial bore + wall thickness) plus one full dx reference layer, unioned with node padding before grid rounding. The reference layer and half-cell are structural grid geometry, not new fitted rows. This is a conservative Peskin grid arm, not a conform P2 calibration or completion of FLUID-CONFORM. No outcome-fitted margin.

water at 37 C, 0.692 mPa.s (CRC Handbook; 1.002 is the 20 C value, which stood here as 'water at 37 C' until 2026-09-21). Definition: a step is converged when, at every node, the displacement its remaining force would cause (|g_i|/D_i, the D-bound of A^-1 g since A >= D) is at most eps times the displacement the same step's thermal noise causes (sigma_i = sqrt(2 kT gamma_i/dt)/D_i, the anchor shift thermal._kick_one draws). Value argued from the definition, not from outcomes: an error of eps sigma changes the per-step displacement variance by <= eps^2 if uncorrelated with the kick (<= 2 eps + eps^2 if fully correlated, a bias); eps = 0.1 -> 1 %, which a variance (MSD, fluctuation spectrum) estimated from N independent samples resolves only for N >~ 2/eps^4 = 2e4 (relative SE sqrt(2/N)) — below the resolution of the ensembles this engine reports per step. Not chosen to pass or to tighten: on the U1/MINI builds kT/dx corresponds to eps_i = sigma_i,free/(2 dx) = 1.28 (actin, dt 1e-4), 4.05 (dt 1e-3), 12.8 (dt 1e-2) (dev/experiments/tol_rule_study --map); the declared convergence study (PENDING_DEFAULT_FLIPS tol-rule-intrinsic) tests the definition's claim. CORRECTED 2026-10-09 (Codex review NN-2026-10-09-convergence-definition-review; PI 15:20 AUTO-1009-ALL): |g_i|/s_i <= eps is a BACKWARD-ERROR statement (the end iterate solves the step exactly under an extra nodal force of at most eps x the kick scale); |g_i|/D_i is NOT a per-node bound on the displacement error (A >= D bounds the whole D-norm only) and the variance figures above are conditional scale arguments (uncorrelated residual and kick are not shown). eps = 0.1 is the arm under verification; also the thermal fraction of tol_rule = intrinsic
